Law Passed: 2021, under An Act To Support and Improve Municipal Recycling Programs and Save Taxpayer Money (LD 1541).
Bagging Scope: Covered as packaging material regardless of type (plastic, paper, etc.); no bagging carve-out.
Other Materials Note: Law applies to nearly all consumer packaging categories, not just bagging.
Status Detail: Implementation is underway; Maine updated the law in 2025, expects producer registration/data reporting in May 2026 and first annual payments in September 2027 for 2026 packaging.
Milestones: Fees tied to volume/type of packaging. SO not yet selected as of mid-2026; RFP issued June 15, 2026.
Suggested Status Detail Update: Stewardship organization had not yet been selected as of mid-2026; state issued an RFP for the SO on June 15, 2026.

Law Passed: 2025, under SB 5284 (the Recycling Reform Act, or WRAP Act).
Bagging Scope: Covered under general packaging definition; includes plastic film and flexible packaging.
Status Detail: Rulemaking, program design and early implementation underway.
Milestones: PRO appointed by Jan 1 2026; registration with Ecology by Mar 1 2026; supply report due May 31 2026; producer participation required by July 1 2026.
Suggested Status Detail Update: By January 1, 2026, obligated producers were required to appoint a PRO, with formal PRO registration with the Department of Ecology by March 1, 2026; simplified material supply report due May 31, 2026.
Suggested Milestones Update: CAA program plan for Washington due October 1, 2028.

Law Passed: 2021, under the Plastic Pollution and Recycling Modernization Act (SB 582).
Bagging Scope: Covered under general packaging definition; flexible film and bags included.
Status Detail: Program rules finalized; producer registration required and fees underway.
Milestones: Fees by material/recyclability/volume. Feb 2026: federal injunction for NAW members; trial July 13, 2026. DEQ published ~300 non-compliant producers Apr 9, 2026, fines up to $25k/day.
Suggested Status Detail Update: On Feb. 6, 2026, a federal judge granted NAW a preliminary injunction (limited to NAW members) on Dormant Commerce Clause/Due Process grounds; trial set for July 13, 2026. Oregon DEQ published a Producer Status List of ~300 non-compliant producers on April 9, 2026, with fines up to $25,000/day for non-registration.

Law Passed: 2025, under SB 901 (the Packaging and Paper Products – Producer Responsibility Plans Act).
Bagging Scope: Covered under general packaging and paper products definition.
Other Materials Note: Explicitly includes paper products alongside packaging.
Milestones: CAA registration by July 1 2026; simplified supply report (2025 data) due May 31 2026; covered materials list by July 1 2027; full plans due July 1 2028.
Suggested Status Detail Update: Producers must register with CAA by July 1, 2026, with a simplified supply report (2025 data) due May 31, 2026. Regulators to list covered materials by July 1, 2027.
Suggested Milestones Update: Comprehensive responsibility plans due from the PRO by July 1, 2028, financed via reimbursements starting 2028, increasing to a maximum by 2030.

Law Passed: 2022, under the Plastic Pollution Prevention and Packaging Producer Responsibility Act (SB 54).
Bagging Scope: Covered as single-use plastic packaging; bags/film included in reduction targets.
Other Materials Note: Also covers single-use plastic food service ware.
Status Detail: Aggressive timeline with ongoing rulemaking implementation underway.
Milestones: 25% source reduction and 65% recycling of plastic by 2032; PRO participation by 2027. Permanent regs finalized May 1 2026. Facing state and federal (17 AGs + NAW) legal challenges; no injunction granted as of writing.
Suggested Status Detail Update: Permanent regulations finalized May 1, 2026; program implementation targeted for Jan. 1, 2027. Facing a state-court challenge and a June 22, 2026 federal suit by 17 state AGs (led by Nebraska) plus NAW alleging Dormant Commerce Clause, First Amendment, and unlawful-delegation violations. No injunctive relief granted as of this writing; compliance obligations remain in force.
Suggested Milestones Update: Individual Source Reduction Plans due Aug. 1, 2026; malus fees begin ~2027 (est. $25/ton, rising to $500-700/ton by 2032).

Law Passed: 2022, under the Producer Responsibility Program for Statewide Recycling Act (HB22-1355).
Bagging Scope: Covered under general packaging definition; bags/film included.
Status Detail: CAA appointed as PRO in 2023; mandatory participation since July 1, 2025; annual dues began January 2026.
Milestones: Producers began reporting 2025. Mar 2026: lawsuit challenging a second PRO (LPMA) for petroleum/automotive products - not bagging-relevant.
Suggested Status Detail Update: In March 2026, the Independent Lubricant Manufacturers Association sued CDPHE challenging delegation of authority to LPMA (a second PRO alongside CAA for petroleum/automotive products).

Law Passed: 2024, under the Packaging Waste and Cost Reduction Act (HF 3911/SF 3877).
Bagging Scope: Covered under general packaging definition; bags/film included.
Milestones: Limited registration 2025-2026; PRO operations begin 2027-2028; full requirements (reusable/recyclable/compostable) by 2032.
Suggested Status Detail Update: Producers subject to limited registration requirements 2025-2026; PRO to begin operations 2027-2028.
Suggested Milestones Update: Full stewardship plan implementation 2029-2032; substantive packaging requirements take effect 2032.
